Usage: astryx theme targets [options] [filter]

List the component theming targets a theme can override

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

Exit codes:
  0  success
  1  a filter matches no target, or core cannot be resolved

Examples:
  # The whole themeable surface
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme targets
  # One component's targets
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme targets Switch
  # Search keys
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 theme targets thumb
  # For a lint or an audit script
  npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 --json theme targets

More: npx @astryxdesign/cli@0.7.12 docs cli/commands/theme-targets
